svg.text: DT5-F01 · Motor fit through truck articulation
Width-plane check using CAD vertices; motor shown at limiting sampled combination. This is not an accepted body clearance.
The shorter157mm coupling and revised carrier replace the270mm ROTEX package; geared coupling has new lubrication requirements.
Width-plane compliance does not prove separation from every frame/body part, actual brake or route obstacle.
Frame-owner acceptance, continuous motion, actual OEM motor CAD and tolerance/deflection allowances remain open.
DT5 R1 · 20 October 2026 · mm · Development geometry; supplier and structural approval required before fabrication.
